title: Bound plane-bus IPC waits by bus_timeout_ms
goal: Vision: V-10. Prerequisite for moving pillar implementations out of core (Mandate 84, rule 5): core will wait on pillar work another process serves. plane_bus_ipc post sets no read timeout, so a hung peer hangs the caller. Honour a payload bus_timeout_ms (milliseconds the caller waits from sending; the bus_ prefix keeps it apart from topic fields named timeout_ms or deadline_ms) as the read timeout; answer 'plane bus: deadline exceeded' on expiry without pruning the route, since a slow peer is not a dead one; and refuse a request whose time is already spent without running it. Session scopes are out of scope: they stay in-process (scoped_tools_pin_owner_requests_to_local_prefixes); a scoped chain moves as one unit or returns tool_calls to its caller.

reuse.searched: core plane_bus_ipc post/remote/prune_stale_route_file/serve_conn (where the timeout and the slow-versus-dead distinction go); the plug-host side already speaks bus_timeout_ms.

limitations: Core is at its ceiling (291,809 lines on 2026-11-17), so the change is offset by deleting unreferenced code in the same task. Windows x86_64 first.
progress: Narrowed from scope lending plus timeout to the timeout only, after surveying the scope's users.
